lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Nvidia slumps after a ‘foreign intelligence’ probe initiated by AI company into CEO Jensen Huang, The Associated Press reports.
Trump does not currently have a press secretary after briefly giving the job to Katie Zacharia, who left the post after five days, The Associated Press reports.

Comedian Russell Brand, once one of ‌Britain’s most high-profile broadcasters and briefly a motion picture star, was sentenced to 10-and-a-half years in prison on Monday after being convicted for rape and three sexual assaults, Reuters reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
